name: Kumba Iron Ore Limited
source: CRON 20261019: H1 2026 finance, pre-tax and tax rows added from the reviewed interim results for the six months ended 30 June 2026 (Anglo American Kumba interim results booklet 2026, condensed consolidated statement of profit or loss, Rand million). Printed: revenue 30,877, other operating income nil, operating expenses (23,339), expected credit losses (19), operating profit 7,519, finance income 505, finance costs (154), share of losses of joint venture and associate (2), profit before taxation 7,868, taxation (2,412), profit for the period 5,456, of which owners 4,149, non-controlling interests 1,307, basic EPS 12.95 rand. Net Finance Costs is entered as NEGATIVE 351 because the panel has one net row: finance costs 154 less finance income 505 is net finance income of 351. Cost of Sales and Gross Profit are left empty because Kumba presents its income statement by nature and prints no cost of sales line; operating expenses include the 19 credit loss line as in the prior years. Profit before tax also bears the 2 share of joint venture and associate losses, for which the panel has no row, so EBIT less net finance costs gives 7,870 against the printed 7,868. Net Profit is the owners' share, the file's convention for every year, so it is 4,149 rather than the 5,456 total that includes non-controlling interests. Source: https://www.angloamericankumba.com/~/media/Files/A/Anglo-American-Group-v9/Kumba/investors/annual-reporting/2026-interim-results-booklet.pdf
